Discovery

I likely discovered Siivagunner in March 2018 either through Simpleflips 1 2 Oatmeal, or TerminalMontage Something About Yoshi's Island.<br> I probably watched a Simpleflips stream clip with Siivagunner songs, such as https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9kXaZUPwCwg

Siivagunner has greatly informed my music taste, introducing me to Soundcloud style music sampling.
